# Test fixtures

All assets here are test-only, not real book content or printer profiles.

- `test-only.ttf` / `.otf`: original geometric glyphs, CC0; generated by `../make-test-font.py` using fontTools.
- `test-only-cmyk.icc`: original synthetic ICC v2 LUT, CC0. It deliberately maps channels to synthetic Lab values and is unsuitable for any print job. Reproduce with `../make-color-fixtures.py`.
- `test-srgb.icc`: standard sRGB generated with Pillow/LittleCMS, no vendor printer characterization data. The generator includes a profile creation timestamp.
- `test-cmyk.jpg`: original 8×8 four-color test pattern, CC0; Pillow JPEG encoding. Used to verify CMYK channels before color conversion.

No Founder installer, native project, template, font or artwork is included. Tests against locally supplied native samples are separate and are never bundled.
